launch_evidence.quote: We recognized our first sales of IBSRELA in the U.S. in March 2022.

series_start_reason: IBSRELA sales began in March 2022. The first printed product sales line is the Q1 2022 10-Q (450 thousand), so the series starts 2022Q1.
notes: Scope is IBSRELA U.S. net product sales. The product sales line was IBSRELA only until XPHOZAH launched in November 2023; from the FY2023 annual report IBSRELA is printed on its own row, and the FY2023 and later Q4 figures are derived from that row less nine months. Ex-U.S. product supply revenue and Kyowa Kirin royalties are not in this series.
search_log: Bigdata search for IBSRELA net product revenue by quarter; results confirmed U.S. net product sales and the XPHOZAH split from Q4 2023.
Listed every 10-Q and 10-K for CIK 1437402 via data.sec.gov submissions; read the IBSRELA or product sales row of each filing.
2022 quarters: Q2 and Q3 from the 2022 10-Qs; Q1 2022 from the Q1 2022 10-Q; Q4 2022 derived from the FY2022 10-K less nine months.
Q4 2023, 2024 and 2025 derived from the full-year IBSRELA line less the nine-month figure.
FDA approval letter for NDA 211801 read for the indication sentence; approval year 2019 from the original approval letter.
